Daily Devotional

November 17

14 Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross; (Colossians 2:14 KJV)

The Greek word “EXALEIPHO” that was translated “Blotting out”, means to smear out, obliterate, erase, etc., so it is saying that Jesus did away with the law for all who believe in Him, and so we are no longer under any of the Old Testament Law (Romans 3:21). It also says that we are no longer under the ordinances, in which were thousands of commands to follow. So many Churches have missed this part of what Jesus did, as they tend to still preach that you have to do many works of the law to be right with God, like going to church, keeping the Sabbath, tithing, etc. Does this mean we can ignore the law? No, as the law shows us how God wants us to live and we should study the law so we know how to be pleasing to God. If we are truly born again, we will want to live in a way that will please our Father in Heaven (1 Peter 1:16).

Notice it says that Jesus “took it out of the way” instead of completely doing away with it, as it no longer applies to the born again Christian (Romans 3:28), but it still applies to the unsaved in the world, as they are still under the curse of the law. Jesus literally nailed it to the cross, which means if we accept Jesus as our Savior, then we no longer are under the law, but free from it by the Grace of God. If a Christian could just understand that ALL the law was fulfilled by Jesus for us (Matthew 5:17), meaning that we do not have to have ANY works of the law to be right with the Father. We are made the righteousness of Jesus through faith in Him (Romans 3:22), and not by anything we do ourselves, as it is all a gift from God. Many Christians still think that God responds to the Christian in accordance to the way they live, but that is not so, although we must obey Jesus to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). How we live affects the way we love God, not how He loves us. Praise God for His Grace. WOW, thank you Jesus for all you have done for us!

The code on the left is the legendary Fast Inverse Square Root.

Calculating inverse square roots is necessary for 3D graphics, but a very expensive operation that was a bottleneck for graphics quality for a long time. Originally found in the Quake III Arena source code, this mysterious piece of code abuses bit operations, details of the IEEE floating point specification, and the 0x5F3759DF magic number, to produce very accurate estimates of inverse square roots extremely quickly. At the time of its discovery, and for many years after, this method outperformed even hardware accelerated approaches that used lookup tables.

This method, its origins, and that magic number have been the subject of many talks and research papers, trying to derive why that number works so well and how the madman who wrote this code came up with it. The code and methodology is now well understood, but it took many years to reverse engineer it.

The origins of the code remain shrouded in mystery. It's been theorized it my have been written by John Carmack or Gary Tarolli, but nobody knows for certain. The original author never took credit for his work of genius.

There is no doubt, however, that it was a man.
